In Wonga's survey, fewer than one in four people said they saved through the year for the festive season. Be one of them. Put away R500 a month from January to December and you have R6,000 by Christmas, without touching your December pay. That's exactly how a stokvel works. Saving on your own? Make it automatic: open a separate savings pocket, call it December, and set up a monthly transfer for the day after payday. Money you never see is money you don't spend, and in a savings or money market account it even earns a little interest.

About the example: R500 x 12 months = R6,000.

Full guide: "Festive Season on a Budget: How Not to Start January Broke (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
